Common Tower AC Error Codes

Seeing a strange code on your AC display? Here’s what some common errors mean. For a definitive solution, call our Tower AC technician.

Error Code: E1/F1

Meaning: Indoor temperature sensor error. The unit may not cool or heat correctly.

Solution: Check for loose connections. If the issue persists, the sensor likely needs replacement. Call us for a quick fix.

Error Code: E4/F4

Meaning: Communication error between indoor and outdoor units.

Solution: This is often a complex wiring or PCB issue. We strongly recommend professional inverter ac repair to avoid further damage.

Error Code: P2/CH05

Meaning: High-pressure protection, often due to a dirty outdoor coil or fan issue.

Solution: Turn off the AC. Ensure the outdoor unit is clean and free of debris. If the error returns, it requires a professional check-up.

Frequently Asked Questions

How often should I get my Tower AC serviced?

For optimal performance and longevity, we recommend a professional Tower AC service at least once a year, preferably before the summer season begins. For units in high-usage commercial environments, servicing twice a year is ideal.

What are the signs that my floor standing AC needs repair?

Common signs include the Tower AC not cooling effectively, making unusual noises (grinding, rattling), floor standing AC water leakage, the unit frequently turning on and off, or a sudden increase in your electricity bills. If you notice any of these, it’s time to call a Tower AC technician.

Do you provide emergency Tower AC repair in Gujarat?

Yes, we offer emergency Tower AC repair Gujarat wide, including in cities like Vadodara, Ahmedabad, and Surat. Our team is available 24/7 to address urgent repair needs.

What is included in a standard Tower AC service?

A standard Tower AC service includes cleaning of indoor and outdoor unit coils, filter cleaning/replacement, checking refrigerant levels, inspecting electrical components, clearing the drain line, and a full system performance check. Our deep cleaning ac service provides an even more thorough cleanse.

Are your technicians certified to handle all AC brands?

Absolutely. Our technicians are highly trained and certified to perform Tower air conditioner service on all major brands, including LG, Voltas, Daikin, Samsung, Blue Star, Hitachi, and more.

How quickly can a technician reach my location in Vadodara?

We pride ourselves on rapid response. For service in areas like Gotri Tower AC service or Tower AC repair Manjalpur, we typically dispatch a technician to be at your doorstep within 90 minutes of your call.

What is the difference between portable AC and tower AC?

A tower AC (or floor standing AC) is a stationary, high-capacity unit. A portable AC is smaller, has wheels, and can be moved between rooms, typically using an exhaust hose through a window. We offer both portable AC repair and tower AC services.
